realizes.rationale: Both the native-input callable and native-summary callable receive the comparison number, with the observer after that key. The serving cache forwards that same key to both. This carries explicit numbered-comparison selection through dependency observation and computation instead of dropping the number at the port boundary.

Names the summary question as repository, master, leaf and comparison number (None means ordinary leaf resolution). IntentSummaryCache._response actually constructs and uses this four-part key for native inputs, read and retained-answer identity, so two numbered comparisons cannot share one question key. Root must verify locator admission for this Python type alias before writing an entry.
The cache owns the window, puts it in the key and mints a new one as time passes, so no admission record can reproduce an old key.
